title: Jaguar
description: Jaguar's identity has long rested on black (#000000), white (#ffffff), and silver (#bfbfbf), echoing its leaping-cat heritage. In November 2024 the company unveiled a striking new "Exuberant Modernism" direction built around bold new tones it calls Miami Pink and London Blue as it repositions as an all-electric luxury brand, though it has not published official hex values for the new palette.
